title: Knobelaufgaben
metaDescription: Markus hat 10 Gelb und 15 Rot, Anton hat 75 und Laura 50 Gummibärchen. Finde heraus, wie viele jeder hat.
content: {"id":"0b636865-8048-48bd-b514-5977508d5629","type":"https://serlo.org/editor","variant":"serlo-org","domainOrigin":"serlo.org","version":2,"editorVersion":"0.22.0","dateModified":"2025-02-26T18:22:19.205Z","document":{"plugin":"exercise","state":{"content":{"plugin":"rows","state":[{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Markus hat 10 gelbe und 15 rote Gummibärchen. Bestimme wie viele Gummibärchen nun jeder hat."}]}],"id":"b611f9f7-ce4e-4e50-8bed-e550cc754f51"}],"id":"093ad3a9-2f0f-4772-919d-ad2026687099"},"solution":{"plugin":"solution","state":{"strategy":{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Markus hat insgesamt 25 Gummibärchen.
